channel.title: Madagascar - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Madagascar, every source cited.

item.title: Madagascar university officials detained over fake diplomas
item.description: Three leaders at Itasy University in Soavinandriana face pre-trial detention for alleged diploma fraud.

item.title: US donates technology to Madagascar health ministry
item.description: American officials provided digital tools to support frontline health workers in data collection and transmission.

item.title: Madagascar president seeks economic ties with Russia
item.description: Colonel Michaël Randrianirina highlighted energy, agriculture, and health as key sectors for new partnerships.

item.title: Madagascar pledges women in ocean conservation
item.description: The island nation joins Belize in a global initiative to integrate women into marine resource decision-making.

item.title: Madagascar and Turkey seek more investment
item.description: The two nations aim to boost economic ties and development projects, focusing on energy, education, and trade.
